80167.subject: Early access, new integrations, and more
80167.body:
Hey, it's Zeno.

This month, we completed the first phase of our Headless Dashboard Initiative https://resend.com/blog/headless-dashboard-initiative?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link. Use Resend wherever you want (i.e., CLI, MCP, API, or Dashboard). We also shipped Stripe https://resend.com/changelog/stripe-projects-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link and v0 integrations https://resend.com/changelog/v0-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link, SSO support https://resend.com/changelog/sso?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link, our next video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRdRxqqkCRQ in our Builder Stories series, and more.

And don't forget, Resend Forward https://forward.resend.com/register/discount/RESEND-USER?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=button, our one-day conference dedicated to crafting high-quality software, is on October 21, just 3 weeks away.

Quick question:

> We're planning Q4 initiatives. What should we build?

Have ideas? Hit reply. We read every answer.





EARLY ACCESS TO INBOXES

https://resend.com/help?type=report&message=I+would+like+early+access+to+Inboxes.&priority=low

We're building a new product to help people (and their agents) create inboxes. If you're interested in trying it out before anyone else, we would love to hear your feedback and shape this new thing with you.

→ Get early access https://resend.com/help?type=report&message=I+would+like+early+access+to+Inboxes.&priority=low





BUILD HOW YOU WANT

https://resend.com/blog/headless-dashboard-initiative?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=image

You should have control that's predictable and accessible from any surface you prefer: the dashboard, MCP, CLI, or the API. Humans and agents alike should have equal access with the developer as the operator.

→ Read the post https://resend.com/blog/headless-dashboard-initiative?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=button





SEND EMAILS FROM YOUR STRIPE PROJECT

https://resend.com/changelog/stripe-projects-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=image

Stripe Projects lets you and your AI agents assemble a project's infrastructure from the Stripe CLI. A single command creates a Resend account, generates an API key, and adds it to your environment.

→ Explore the integration https://resend.com/changelog/stripe-projects-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_09_product_newsletter&utm_content=button





SIGN IN WITH YOUR IDENTITY PROVIDER
